hero.kicker: Made in China · direct from the makers
hero.lead: A small, curated edit from the workshops that make them. Hand-cast night lights and hand-lacquered tea ware — no marketplace middlemen, no mystery sellers.
hero.sub: From Dehua celadon to crystal resin, every piece carries the hand of its maker.

maker.body: MADE IN CN is a small edit of objects we can trace to a person and a place. We work directly with the studios, name the makers, and show the process — because “made in China” should mean something you can feel.

shop.title: Three objects. Three makers.
shop.note: Collector lamps from a Shenzhen resin studio, and a lacquer cup by Master Lin Jianjun in Dehua.

heritage.body: Master Lin Jianjun floats a real maple leaf through layer after layer of lacquer, then finishes the interior in pale celadon. Each cup is shaped, cured and polished by hand in Dehua — and arrives in a fitted gift box with its certificate.

compare.title: Skip the middleman.
compare.note: No mystery seller. No marketplace markup.

bundle.body: Pikachu and Gengar together — a warm glow and a little midnight. Both arrive in collector packaging.

closing.body: A small edit of objects with a maker, a material and a reason to keep them.
